stemMd: A report states: Every specimen in tray T is sterile. What is the logical negation of this statement?

options.label: A
options.textMd: At least one specimen in tray T is not sterile.

options.label: B
options.textMd: At least one specimen outside tray T is sterile.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No specimen in tray T is sterile.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every specimen in tray T is sterile or labelled.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Most specimens in tray T are not sterile.

explanationMd: A universal statement is false if there is at least one counterexample. Negation does not require all or most specimens to fail the property.

distractorRationale.b: That says nothing about tray T.
distractorRationale.d: This can be true alongside the original.
distractorRationale.c: This is stronger than needed to negate every.
distractorRationale.e: A single exception already defeats the original.
